title: Creative Production Manager
description:
Long Term Contract
Onsite 5 days/week either in CA or NYC


Role Overview
Our Client is seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Creative Production Manager to join our Brand Creative team. This is pivotal in supporting all soccer-related properties – including UEFA Champions League, UEFA Europa League, UEFA Conference League, Serie A, NWSL, EFL, Carabao Cup, and more – as well as other core brand initiatives. Reporting directly to the VP of Brand Creative, this role will help bring our storytelling to life across platforms, ensuring seamless execution and creative excellence in every deliverable.

Key Responsibilities
• Manage end-to-end production workflows for soccer and core property creative requests.
• Coordinate with internal teams including marketing, creative content, and digital to ensure timely delivery of assets.
• Support the Brand Creative team by serving as the primary liaison between the team and all internal and external stakeholders including vendors/agencies for soccer-related content. Handling all internal/external communication, inputting and maintaining Airtable requests, setting internal/external meetings to review creative.
• Track project timelines, budgets, and deliverables using project management tools.
• Ensure brand consistency and creative quality across all executions.
• Coordinate with stakeholders to aggregate toolkit due dates for each league in addition to all relevant assets/materials across all leagues.
• Create and shepherd team through comprehensive production schedule from ideation/development to Digital Master Canvas (DMC) and motion toolkit creation, scripting, and Lyric builds
o Work with Artist and Lyric team to ensure all layouts throughout the season adhere to established look
• Support Art Director and Artists by QCing logos/messaging/note implementation, pulling player images, devising action plans for last-minute player injuries, managing artist workload and knowing when to suggest internal/external schedule changes
• Coordinate all player image treatments with Art Director and finishing artist
• Ensure new Airtable/Lucid workflows are being adhered to
A/V Versioning
• QC and assign all Airtable requests to artists
• Ensure artists have necessary assets across each league
• Work closely with Producers on all drop-in and promo requests to ensure creative asks are fulfilled

Qualifications
• BA/ BS in Business, Marketing, Production or related field
• 3-5 years of experience in creative production, preferably in sports or entertainment.
• Strong understanding of soccer culture and global soccer properties.
• Proven ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
• Excellent communication and organizational skills.
• Experience working with creative teams, editors, designers, and producers.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Lyric, AirTable, Frame.io, and Slack.
• Familiarity with broadcast and digital production workflows.
• Passion for storytelling and brand building.


Nice to Have:
Prefer 3-5 yrs experience in sports or entertainment.

title: Marketing Project Manager
description:
Long Term Contract
Onsite - NYC

Role Overview
We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Marketing Project Manager to join our dynamic team. This role will primarily support the Broadcast & Cable Promos teams by managing project workflows, coordinating asset requests, and ensuring timely delivery of promotional materials. The ideal candidate will be a collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates strong ownership of tasks, and is flexible in supporting broader marketing initiatives as needed.

Key Responsibilities
· Track and manage the workflow of Broadcast & Cable Promos projects from initiation to completion.
· Submit requests for all versions of promotional content, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
· Coordinate and submit graphics requests for promos in a timely manner.
· Deliver A/V assets to internal and external agencies and partners for paid media campaigns.
· Monitor project timelines and proactively follow up with team members to ensure deadlines are met.
· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support broader marketing initiatives as needed.
· Maintain clear documentation and status updates for ongoing projects.
· Identify and escalate potential project risks or delays to leadership.

Qualifications
· BA/ BS in Business, Marketing, Production or related field
· 2-3 years of experience in marketing project management or a related field.
· Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
· Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, AirTable, Frame.io, and Slack.
· Experience working with creative teams and external vendors/agencies.
· Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
· Ability to adapt to shifting priorities and support various marketing functions as needed.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Long Term Contract
Remote 

Daily
The main function of a project coordinator is to support project managers and project teams on a project. The coordinator ensures that no resources are being allocated to unnecessary tasks and that all aspects of the project are completed as quickly as possible.

Job Responsibilities / Typical Day in the Role
• Maintain and update project trackers to ensure accurate progress reporting
• Set up and manage document folders for team access and publication workflows
• Coordinate and schedule stakeholder review meetings
• Track and summarize changes requiring communication or additional approvals
• Edit and format documents (e.g., articles, policies, programs) according to guidelines
• Review and analyze testing outcomes to ensure accuracy and completeness

Must Have Skills / Requirements
1) Proficiency in ServiceNow
2) Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
3) Experienced with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
4) Excellent proofreading and attention to detail
5) Utilize discretion and judgement to maintain confidentiality of sensitive data
Nice to Have Skills / Preferred Requirements
1) HTML experience is nice to have, but this position does not require any coding.
Soft Skills
1) Strong communication skills with wide variety of business partners and levels
2) Strong interpersonal and relationship building skills
3) Extremely detailed oriented and organized
4) Must be supportive team member as an active participant and contributor

Education / Certifications
1) High School diploma or equivalent required

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
6 Month contract with possible extension
Hybrid - 3 days in person



As Senior Product Designer for Core XD (Core Experience Design), you will be involved in every aspect of the product design process, from initial brainstorm sessions to final pixel tweaks, through delivery for our customers. You will utilize a full range of product design, interaction design, and visual design skills, and contribute to the final product experience. You will work closely with a talented team of designers, product managers, engineers, researchers, writers, and international partners.
The Senior Product Designer demonstrates strong ability across four key areas: Product Design expertise, Customer Focus, Collaboration, and Impact.

The Daily
Deliver appropriate design artifacts spanning all project phases, from concept development and design to production and documentation (e.g., evaluations, task flows, user scenarios, information architecture, interaction models, wireframes, low- and high-fidelity prototypes, specs and guidelines).
• Develop, present, and advocate for your work.
• Collaborate with product managers, engineers, researchers, writers, and international partners, as well as other design team colleagues.
• Use research and data to inform design and collaborate with team members to understand and interpret stakeholder feedback.
• Help identify customer problems and solutions with limited guidance and direction; is aware of the impact on the larger ecosystem.
• Convert ambiguity and opportunity into design solutions.
• Support product and design strategies and long-term goals and vision, with limited guidance and direction.
• Help strike a balance between user goals and business needs to craft win-win experiences for our customers and our business.
• Contribute to creating a fun and supportive culture that allows us to make career-defining user experiences.

Qualifications
• 5+ years in Product Design or related field.
• A BA/BS degree in UX Design, Product Design, Industrial Design, graphic design or related and equivalent product and/or agency work experience.
• Expertise with industry-standard design tools, primarily Figma.
• Experience defining, prototyping and executing UX, UI and Visual design features on multiple platforms to ensure cohesive consumer experience.
• Ability to communicate and explain design concepts and decisions to cross-functional teams with reasoning.
• Able to analyze and apply customer data and feedback and use this to drive design designs.
• A portfolio that demonstrates strong visual and interaction design skills, as well as a laser focus on user needs and considerations.
• Experience designing cohesive cross-platform experiences including mobile, connected TV, and web.
• Proven ability to create detailed, comprehensive and attractive design artifacts, from user flows to wireframes, mockups to interactive prototypes.
• A holistic approach to problem solving that results in elegantly simple solutions to complex challenges.
• Demonstrable understanding and application of core design skills including composition, typography, and color theory.
• Evidence of strong design systems thinking that connects individual features to the overall product experience.
• Ability to synthesize ideas and feedback from various sources including stakeholders, end users and product design colleagues.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong listening, analytical and organizational skills.
• Experience with current product design best practices including Agile Development and Lean UX.
• An energetic, positive, self-starter attitude.
• Passion for movies, series, sports, and social media, as well as a desire to stay on top of industry trends.

Job Responsibilities / Typical Day in the Role
• You will be responsible for creating design concepts based on requirements and an understanding of technologies and best practices.
• Ability to work within a robust and evolved design system while collaborating with our design system teammates.
• Ability to help us improve and streamline processes and workflows while design best practices are in place and deadlines are met.
• Synthesize customer feedback, research, and data and utilize it to ensure designs are meeting customer needs.
• Responsible for expanding on existing design templates, modules and patters.
• Create prototypes of features and interactions with different levels of fidelity to ensure understanding of design solutions.
• Take user data and feedback to identify key customer problems and create solutions.
• Present findings, concepts, and design solutions to cross-functional team members and stakeholders.
• Own the end-to-end feature design process and assist in defining workstream planning and timelines, including user research, analyzing customer data, presenting design, gaining buy in from stakeholders, through to design specs and feature delivery.




Work Experience
UX Design and Product Design
Tv Streaming a Bonus

Education, Professional Training, Technical Training or Certification

Nice to Have Skills / Preferred Requirements
This role is heavily focused on strong product user experience and visual design, requiring exceptional attention to detail. The ideal candidate will excel in creating elegant user interfaces and producing visually compelling and easily consumable presentations for their work. Proficiency in prototyping is advantageous, and experience with motion design is a plus.
